features: Designed for Data Center Modular Hardware Systems (DC-MHS) to simplify CSP deployments and serviceability
Optimized power & balanced performance for cloud applications

CPU: Intel® Xeon® 6 6700 series processors with E-cores
Note: Supports up to 350W TDP CPUs (Air Cooled)

Max GPU Count: Up to 3 double-width or 6 single-width GPU(s)

Memory: Max Memory (2DPC): Up to 2TB 6400MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM

NVMe: NVMe; RAID 0/1/5/10 support(VROC HW key required)

LAN: 1 RJ45 1 GbE Dedicated IPMI LAN port(s)

Hardware: Silicon Root of Trust (RoT) – NIST 800-193 Compliant

PCI-Express (PCIe) Configuration: Default 4 PCIe 5.0 x16 (in x16) FHFL slot(s)
Option A 2 PCIe 5.0 x16 (in x16) FHFL slot(s)
CXL Support: Up to 3 internal CXL 2.0 x16/x8 Type 2/Type 3 devices

Drive Bays Configuration: Default: Total 12 bay(s) 12 front hot-swap 2.5" NVMe*/SAS*/SATA* drive bay(s)
(*NVMe/SAS/SATA support may require additional storage controller and/or cables, please see the optional parts list for details)
M.2: 2 M.2 PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe slot(s) (M-key 22110(default)/2280; VROC required for RAID)

Fans: 4x 8cm heavy duty fans with optimal fan speed control
